title: Cushion: soft-robotics simulation in Grasshopper, powered by SOFA
description: A Grasshopper plugin that connects parametric modeling in Rhino and Grasshopper to SOFA's soft-body finite-element solver. Deformable bodies, pneumatic cavities, tendons, stiffened regions, and actuation schedules are defined as components; Cushion meshes the geometry, runs the SOFA simulation, and returns trajectories, forces, contacts, and deformed shapes to Grasshopper.
